# Official checkpoint metadata fixtures

These three small JSON files are unchanged copies from
[Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct/tree/7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775).
The model is published under Apache-2.0. The matching chat-template text in
`src/tokenizer/qwen_chat_template.jinja` is extracted verbatim from tokenizer_config.json
for exact policy validation; Ferrum does not execute Jinja. No weights or tokenizer
vocabulary are included in these fixtures.
